topic: sub:12|Relative frequency and probability|Expected frequency, np

parts.latex:
The probability that a new variety of seed will produce flowers in the first year of growth after being planted is 0.4. There were 200 seeds of this new variety planted.

How many of the seeds would be the expected frequency to NOT produce flowers in the first year ?

solutions.latex:
$$P(\text{not flowers}) = 1 - 0.4 = 0.6$$

$$\begin{aligned} \text{Expected number} &= 0.6\times 200 \\ &= 120 \end{aligned}$$

So $120$ seeds are expected not to produce flowers.
